mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (the 25th percentile of the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points within a month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth expansion regime (INDPRO above 105), a decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% within a month signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% in a month during high-growth expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) above the 50th percentile of the last 12 months indicate strong consumer demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 3.5% (annualized) signals persistent inflationary pressures, which may trigger monetary tightening and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 below 1.5% annualized) and declining retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 is below 1.5% annualized and RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4%), a decline in non-farm payrolls exceeding 50,000 in a month signals weakening economic activity, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines by more than 50k in a month during tight labor market conditions (UNRATE < 4%).
